column3: {p}: You have disrespected the trees in this area, but this is what we have come to expect from your stunted kind. Further abuse cannot be tolerated. Let this be a warning to you.

{p}: What a pleasant surprise! Not a single tree here weeps from the abuses meted out with such ease by your people. Joy! The dwarves have turned a page, not that we would make paper. A travesty! Perhaps it is better said that the dwarves have turned over a new leaf, and the springtime for our two races has only just begun.
{p}: Although we do not always see eye to eye (ha!), I bid you farewell. May you someday embrace nature as you embrace the rocks and mud.
{p}: Greetings from the woodlands. We have much to discuss.
{p}: It has been an honor, noble {p}. I bid you farewell.
{p}: Greetings, noble dwarf. There is much to discuss.

{p}: You continue to impress! I have come empowered to elevate this land in the eyes of our realm.

column3: Greetings from the outer lands.  Your efforts are legend there.  Let us trade!
Greetings from the Mountainhomes.  Your efforts are legend there.  Let us trade!
Greetings from our mountain halls to yours.  Let us strengthen our bonds in trade.
Greetings.  The {s}ship of the {s} is unparalleled.  Let's make a deal!
Greetings.  We are enchanted by your more ethical works.  We've come to trade.
A hairy drunkard has come hither to once more disrespect the sanctity of life, I see.
These goods are too heavy and cheap for me to consider.
I cannot take so much -- and at such cost!
Do not tempt me!  My beasts of burden cannot possibly haul such a load.
I wish I could take so much, but my animals...
I must make a profit.  There is simply not enough value here.
I won't trade at a loss.
Please understand the journey must be profitable.  Perhaps you'd consider tossing in a little extra?
Your childish games have made me tired.  Perhaps next time I visit you'll take this seriously.
Leave it to the besotted dullard to miss the finer points of discourse.  I'm leaving.  Do reflect.
You'll need more goods to make this arrangement.  All I see here is not enough.
Even with your combined trade goods, such as they are, I can't fathom you ending up with the items you desire.
Ah, wonderful.  Thank you for your business.
I will see that our leader gets this offering.
Take what you wish.  I can't stop you.
You wish to make an offering to our leader?  This would please us greatly.  What do you offer?
You wish to make an offering?  We love gifts.
[Laughs uproariously]  You had me going there.  Obviously, your copious wit is matched only by your industry!
I am a merchant, yes.  You see, I wish to trade.  Which of my goods do you desire?
Yes, and trade we will!  Simply tell me what interests you and what you're prepared to offer in exchange.
Ah, but my goods are not free!  What do you offer in trade?
These _are_ fine items, aren't they?  Now, what do offer for them?
For me?  At no price?  I can accept your offer, or perhaps you wish to trade.
Are these gifts?  Do you wish to trade?
My stones, are you giving me those?  Do you wish to trade or to make an offering to our leader?
You truly despise life, don't you?  I am beside myself with grief.  Perhaps we will show you how they suffered.
Once a beautiful tree, and now?  It is a rude bauble, fit only for your kind.
I see your low race still revels in death.  That poor, gentle creature...
